title: 973. Satisfiability of Equality Equations

examples.explanation: a and b cannot be equal and different simultaneously.
Setting both to the same value satisfies each equation.
The equalities force a, b and c together, contradicting b!=c.

hints: Handle all == equations first by merging the two sides into shared groups with a union-find structure.
Then check every != equation: if both sides landed in the same group, the system is contradictory.
Only 26 variables exist, so the union-find arrays stay tiny.
